parts.answer: For normal renal function (eGFR >=90), the starting dose is 50 mg OD, the maximum is 100 mg/day, and monitoring is routine. For mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89), the starting dose is 50 mg OD, the maximum is 100 mg/day, and monitoring is routine. For moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the starting dose is 25 mg once daily (25 mg OD), the maximum is 50 mg/day, and monitoring is recheck 2-4 weeks. For severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29), the starting dose is specialist review, the maximum is 25 mg/day, and monitoring is enhanced.
